metadata.label: Business enterprise sector’s expenditure for intramural R&D by source of funds and industry. SEK million, every other year 2007-2023
note: The distribution of total external funds to exchange funds and transfer funds is available from 2017.
The increase of R&D expenditure in research institutes from 2017 to 2019 is partly caused by changes in respondent calculation methods. The shift can thus be considered a time series break.

From reference year 2023 a new method to ensure confidentiality has been implemented. This means that no values are suppressed. This change can affect the comparability with previous years on a detailed level.

Correction 2025-09-11: Intramural R&D expenditure in NACE 45-47+55-56 concerning reference year 2023 has been corrected. The share of exchange funds and transfer funds in NACE 29-30 concerning reference year 2023 has been corrected.
